mapper.select: SELECT comment.id , comment.deleted , comment.created_at as createdAt , comment.modified_at as modifiedAt , comment.post_id as postId , comment.user_id as userId , comment.content , comment.username as username FROM comment LEFT JOIN user ON comment.user_id = user.id WHERE comment.id = #{id}

SELECT comment.id ,comment.deleted ,comment.created_at as createdAt ,comment.modified_at as modifiedAt ,comment.post_id as postId ,comment.user_id as userId ,comment.content ,user.username as username FROM comment LEFT JOIN user ON comment.user_id = user.id
ORDER BY comment.created_at ASC

SELECT comment.id, comment.deleted, comment.created_at as createdAt, comment.modified_at as modifiedAt, comment.post_id as postId, comment.user_id as userId, comment.content, user.username as username FROM comment LEFT JOIN user ON comment.user_id = user.id
ORDER BY comment.id ORDER BY comment.created_at DESC ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{perpage}
